caveats: Request cad_number and geom only; preserve native ID strings including leading zeroes. GeoServer transport feature IDs are not stable parcel identities.
Native EPSG:3857 is transformed to WGS84 without coordinate rounding, offsets or geometry repair. Requested geographic output was previously rounded to integer degrees.
Do not use resultType=hits: discovery recorded inconsistent zero counts. Runtime validates feature-response match counts and pages completely or fails.
BBOX can match feature envelopes; complete returned polygons are tested for intersection, never clipped.
Bounded observations do not establish full-city distribution, uniqueness, historic/current semantics or reuse rights.
